items_flat.title_en: xAI Introduces Build Mode for Creating Apps, Games and Dashboards with Grok
items_flat.title_zh: xAI 推出 Build Mode：用 Grok 即時建構應用、遊戲與儀表板
items_flat.summary_en: xAI announced Build Mode, now in early beta for SuperGrok Heavy subscribers on web, iOS and Android. Users describe an idea and Grok builds a working website, app, game or interactive dashboard live in the chat, then publishes it to a shareable grok.me link or custom domain.
items_flat.summary_zh: xAI 宣布推出 Build Mode，目前以 Early Beta 提供給 SuperGrok Heavy 訂閱用戶（網頁、iOS、Android）。使用者描述想法後，Grok 會在聊天中即時建構可運作的網站、應用、遊戲或互動儀表板，並可發布到 grok.me 或自訂網域分享。
items_flat.analysis_en: This further collapses the distance between idea and functional software, keeping the entire creation loop inside Grok’s ecosystem. Real production robustness and long-term maintainability of the generated apps remain open questions.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此功能進一步縮短「想法到可運作軟體」的距離，並把整個創作迴路留在 Grok 生態系內。生成應用在真實生產環境的穩定性與長期可維護性仍是關鍵不確定性。
items_flat.quote: Today we're introducing Build Mode, a new way to create with Grok. Tell Grok an idea, and it builds a working version live in your chat, on the web or your phone. When it's ready, publish it to a link anyone can open.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們推出 Build Mode，一種與 Grok 共同創作的新方式。告訴 Grok 一個想法，它就會在聊天中即時建構可運作的版本，可在網頁或手機上使用。完成後可發布成任何人都能開啟的連結。

items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA-Led Open Secure AI Alliance Expands with 40+ Partners Including xAI, Microsoft and Hugging Face
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA 主導的 Open Secure AI Alliance 持續擴大，成員逾 40 家（含 xAI、Microsoft、Hugging Face）
items_flat.summary_en: NVIDIA’s Open Secure AI Alliance, launched 27 July and further promoted on 28 July, brings together more than 40 organizations (including SpaceXAI/xAI, Microsoft, Hugging Face, Mistral, IBM, Linux Foundation and others) to develop open tools, models and harnesses for AI cybersecurity and agent safety. OpenAI, Anthropic and Google are not listed among founding members.
items_flat.summary_zh: NVIDIA 的 Open Secure AI Alliance 於 7 月 27 日成立、28 日持續宣傳，集結逾 40 家組織（含 SpaceXAI／xAI、Microsoft、Hugging Face、Mistral、IBM、Linux Foundation 等），開發開源工具、模型與 harness 以強化 AI 資安與代理安全。OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 未列為創始成員。
items_flat.analysis_en: The alliance frames open models and tooling as defensive assets in the wake of recent closed-model sandbox incidents. Its long-term effectiveness will depend on concrete shared artifacts and whether closed-model labs eventually engage.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 聯盟在近期封閉模型沙盒事件後，將開源模型與工具定位為防禦資產。其長期成效取決於具體共享成果，以及封閉模型實驗室是否最終參與。
items_flat.quote: The Open Secure AI Alliance is growing, with more organizations contributing expertise to help safeguard software and agents.
items_flat.quote_zh: Open Secure AI Alliance 正在擴大，有更多組織貢獻專業，協助守護軟體與代理。

items_flat.title_en: Elon Musk Teases Grok 4.6 (1.5T) Around August 7 and Grok 4.7 (2.1T) Weeks Later
items_flat.title_zh: Elon Musk 預告 Grok 4.6（1.5T）約 8 月 7 日、Grok 4.7（2.1T）數週後推出
items_flat.summary_en: In an X post, Elon Musk stated that Grok 4.6 (1.5T model with significantly improved SFT & RL) is expected around August 7, followed a few weeks later by Grok 4.7 (2.1T model that is better in every way except slightly slower to serve, with improved token efficiency).
items_flat.summary_zh: Elon Musk 在 X 發文指出，Grok 4.6（1.5T 模型，SFT 與 RL 大幅改進）預計約 8 月 7 日發布，數週後推出 Grok 4.7（2.1T 模型，各方面更優，僅服務速度略慢，但 token 效率更好）。
items_flat.analysis_en: The rapid cadence continues xAI’s monthly-foundation-model strategy and keeps competitive pressure on closed rivals. Exact performance gains, pricing and public availability details are still absent.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此快速節奏延續 xAI 每月訓練新基礎模型的策略，並對封閉模型競爭對手保持壓力。確切效能提升、定價與公開可用性細節仍未公布。
items_flat.quote: Grok 4.6 releases around August 7. This will be the 1.5T model with significantly improved SFT & RL. Grok 4.7 will be the 2.1T model released a few weeks later. This will be better than 4.6 in every way, except slightly slower to serve, albeit with even better token efficiency.
items_flat.quote_zh: Grok 4.6 約 8 月 7 日發布。這是 1.5T 模型，SFT 與 RL 大幅改進。Grok 4.7 將在數週後以 2.1T 模型推出，各方面都優於 4.6，僅服務速度略慢，但 token 效率更好。

items_flat.title_en: Meta and BlackRock Announce $14B 1GW Data-Center Venture in El Paso for AI
items_flat.title_zh: Meta 與 BlackRock 宣布 140 億美元 1GW 艾爾帕索資料中心合資案，專供 AI
items_flat.summary_en: Meta and BlackRock announced a joint venture to develop and own a 1-gigawatt data-center campus in El Paso, Texas, with total development costs of approximately $14 billion. BlackRock funds will hold 80% ownership and Meta 20%; the facility is expected online in 2028 and will support Meta’s AI model progress.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta 與 BlackRock 宣布合資開發並擁有德州艾爾帕索一座 1 吉瓦資料中心園區，總開發成本約 140 億美元。BlackRock 基金持有 80% 股權、Meta 持有 20%；預計 2028 年上線，將支援 Meta 的 AI 模型進展。
items_flat.analysis_en: The deal underscores the capital intensity of frontier AI compute and Meta’s willingness to share ownership to accelerate capacity. Actual GPU deployment timelines and power-sourcing details remain to be confirmed.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此案凸顯前沿 AI 算力的資本密集度，以及 Meta 願意分享所有權以加速產能。實際 GPU 部署時程與電力來源細節仍待確認。
items_flat.quote: Building the infrastructure for superintelligence is key to making sure the benefits of this technology are distributed to everyone.
items_flat.quote_zh: 建設超級智慧的基礎設施，是確保這項技術的利益能普及給每個人的關鍵。

items_flat.title_en: Meta Signs EU AI Act Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-Generated Content
items_flat.title_zh: Meta 簽署歐盟 AI 法「AI 生成內容透明度實務守則」
items_flat.summary_en: Meta announced it is signing the EU AI Act Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-Generated Content. The move builds on Meta’s existing labeling work since 2024 and industry efforts such as C2PA, aiming for practical, interoperable identification of AI-generated media without overwhelming users.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta 宣布簽署歐盟 AI 法「AI 生成內容透明度實務守則」。此舉延續自 2024 年以來的標示工作，並與 C2PA 等產業努力一致，目標是提供實用、可互通的 AI 生成媒體識別方式，同時避免過度標籤造成使用者困擾。
items_flat.analysis_en: Signing signals proactive regulatory alignment in Europe while Meta continues to emphasize that transparency must remain usable rather than purely compliance-driven. Implementation details and enforcement timelines will determine real impact.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 簽署顯示 Meta 在歐洲採取主動法規配合，同時強調透明度必須保持可用性而非純合規。實際執行細節與時程將決定真正影響。
items_flat.quote: As AI-generated media becomes more photorealistic, it’s increasingly important that people have tools to help them identify it.
items_flat.quote_zh: 隨著 AI 生成媒體愈來愈逼真，人們愈需要工具來協助識別。
